subject: FYI: /admin/questions/<id> overflows horizontally on phone (Chromium+WebKit) and WebKit iPad portrait, legacy items too
body: Seen in a local render check (Playwright, 390x844 and 820x1180): document scrollWidth exceeds the viewport by about 120-250 px on /admin/questions/ch01-q31 and /admin/questions/mock1-q21 (legacy) as well as on new pack items, with or without a table in the stem. Learn pages are fine. Not content-related; leaving it to the admin page owner.
